owner_rule: Facts create the PBE probability. Kalshi and Polymarket benchmark it afterward. No market/venue price is read anywhere in this evidence.

method.bootstrap: cluster bootstrap B=2000 by date (weather), month (rates), meeting (fed)
method.validation_rule: `skill_validated` iff 95% cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound of BSS > 0 vs EVERY listed baseline (weather: climatology AND the strongest naive reference; rates: Gaussian AND climatology) and n_dates >= 180; `validated` (for CALL) additionally requires that the decision-level holdout evidence supports calls (recommended.allow_call)
method.p_used: published probability (whole percent), as the decision layer will see it
